# SmolLM (HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM-135M) layout for the pebble chip.
#
# Template: pebble/Pythia/CMakeLists.txt — the phase8 realization of the same
# family bind (LlamaForCausalLM importer artifacts placed in the model
# directory ROOT: models/models/SmolLM/forward.mlir + subgraph0.mlir +
# arg0.data, generated by smollm-model-build; NO arg1.data blob — the driver
# buddy-smollm-main.cpp hardcodes the fixed 16 input ids measured from the
# official GPT-2-style BPE tokenizer, which buddy's TextContainer does not
# implement). Runtime deps are arg0.data + vocab.txt only.
# @forward signature (read from the emitted forward.mlir):
#   memref<134515040xf32> + memref<1x16xi64> -> memref<1x16x49152xf32>
# arg0.data = 134,515,040 float32 (538,060,160 B) = 134,515,008 trainable
# params + 32-elem rotary inv_freq buffer (SmolLM/HANDOFF.md; fp32 storage on
# the hub despite the config's bf16 declaration — SmolLM/HANDOFF.md measured
# correction).
#
# Host-linalg form (upstream precedent: pebble/llama2, pebble/BertMedium and
# the phase8 Pythia layout, which never pass -convert-linalg-to-tile /
# -convert-tile-to-buckyball / buckyball_assign_physical_banks): every op of
# both generated graphs lowers to riscv64 host loops and no buckyball dialect
# op is ever created. archs/ CMakeLists.txt defines the tile->buckyball
# machinery variables for pebble, but this layout deliberately does not use
# them. Grounding for that choice is the bind-round observation recorded in
# the PR body (this round, run locally against subgraph0.mlir with the pebble
# per-chip buddy-opt, all invocations exit 0):
#   - SiLU model-path trigger: BREAKPOINT (S3 SiluBall, funct7 59 / ballId 11,
#     IS in the pebble registry since PR #33, yet the 30 silu semantic sites
#     still cannot reach it). The graph decomposes each site into the
#     negate -> exp -> add(1.0) -> reciprocal -> mul five-atom chain
#     (1x16x1536 f32); -convert-linalg-to-tile raises only 751 tile.matmul +
#     332 tile.transpose and leaves every elementwise chain inside
#     linalg.generic (math.exp x90 / math.rsqrt x61 / math.log x30 survive in
#     generics at stage A), and -convert-tile-to-buckyball then produces
#     buckyball.mem_transpose x332 with zero buckyball.silu (grep count 0 at
#     every stage): neither the midend (-convert-linalg-to-tile, matmul/
#     batchmatmul/transpose/quant/mega patterns only) nor the tile->buckyball
#     conversion has any silu/elementwise-activation fusion pattern, so the
#     five-atom chain never becomes a tile op and there is nothing for the
#     n<=256 chunked bb_silu emission (96 calls/site, s2 brief §7.3) to split.
#     The 2,880 calls/forward sharding plan is a contract claim the pipeline
#     cannot generate. Derived spec: D-s-1 (silu five-atom chain fusion
#     linalg->tile->buckyball.silu + chunk emission, core-compiler territory,
#     S3's bank-assign pattern only covers the hand-written mlirtest path).
#   - transpose model-path trigger: compile-reachable (332/332 f32 sites ->
#     buckyball.mem_transpose, bank-SSA + -assign-physical-banks exit 0) but
#     the lane expands this 134M-param host-resident graph to 3,046,453 lines
#     of bank-SSA IR with 266,177 memref.alloc and 131,449 mvin+mvout pairs —
#     the phase8 D-p-1 conclusion re-confirmed on a ~2x larger graph (pythia
#     70M params -> ~1.0M lines / 43,597 pairs) — an unshippable compile/
#     runtime carrier without upstream compiler work.
#   - RMSNorm: BREAKPOINT (same as phase8 D-p-2): the 61 rsqrt sites never
#     leave linalg.generic in either pass (no LayerNorm-pattern trigger; the
#     LayerNormBall C={4,64,256,512}/eps contract does not cover C=576 eps
#     1e-5 RMSNorm anyway, s2 brief §5).
# The driver's per-position argmax fail-hard gate is the layout's correctness
# contract on the host carrier; the canonical reference lives in the workload
# dir (reference/smollm_logits_f32.bin + HANDOFF.md).

set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER ${RISCV_GNU_TOOLCHAIN}/bin/riscv64-unknown-linux-gnu-g++)

set(MODEL_SMOLLM_DIR ${MODEL_DIR}/SmolLM)
set(BUCKYBALL_SMOLLM_DIR ${BUCKYBALL_DIR}/SmolLM)
set(INTERFACE_DIR ${BUDDY_MLIR_DIR}/frontend/Interfaces)

add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT forward.o
  COMMAND ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-opt ${MODEL_SMOLLM_DIR}/forward.mlir
            -pass-pipeline "builtin.module(func.func(tosa-to-linalg-named, tosa-to-linalg, tosa-to-tensor, tosa-to-arith), empty-tensor-to-alloc-tensor, convert-elementwise-to-linalg)" |
          ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-opt
            -buffer-deallocation-simplification
            -convert-linalg-to-loops
            -eliminate-empty-tensors
            -llvm-request-c-wrappers
            -convert-math-to-llvm
            -convert-math-to-libm
            -lower-affine
            -convert-scf-to-cf
            -convert-cf-to-llvm
            -convert-arith-to-llvm
            -expand-strided-metadata
            -finalize-memref-to-llvm
            -convert-func-to-llvm
            -reconcile-unrealized-casts |
          ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-translate --buddy-to-llvmir |
          ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-llc -filetype=obj -mtriple=riscv64 -O2 -mattr=${BUCKYBALL_RISCV_MATTR} -float-abi=hard -o forward.o
  DEPENDS ${MODEL_SMOLLM_DIR}/forward.mlir
  COMMENT "Building forward.o"
  VERBATIM)

add_custom_command(
  OUTPUT subgraph0.o
  COMMAND ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-opt ${MODEL_SMOLLM_DIR}/subgraph0.mlir
            -pass-pipeline "builtin.module(func.func(tosa-to-linalg-named, tosa-to-linalg, tosa-to-tensor, tosa-to-arith))" |
          ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-opt
            -eliminate-empty-tensors
            -convert-elementwise-to-linalg
            -convert-tensor-to-linalg
            -one-shot-bufferize="bufferize-function-boundaries"
            -llvm-request-c-wrappers
            -convert-trace-to-llvm="cycle-trace"
            -expand-strided-metadata
            -convert-linalg-to-loops
            -buffer-deallocation-simplification
            -bufferization-lower-deallocations
            -convert-vector-to-scf
            -lower-affine
            -convert-scf-to-cf
            -convert-cf-to-llvm
            -convert-vector-to-llvm
            -convert-math-to-llvm
            -convert-math-to-libm
            -convert-arith-to-llvm
            -convert-func-to-llvm
            -finalize-memref-to-llvm
            -reconcile-unrealized-casts |
          ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-translate --buddy-to-llvmir |
          ${BUDDY_BINARY_DIR}/buddy-llc -filetype=obj -mtriple=riscv64 -O2 -mattr=${BUCKYBALL_RISCV_MATTR} -float-abi=hard -o subgraph0.o
  DEPENDS ${MODEL_SMOLLM_DIR}/subgraph0.mlir
  COMMENT "Building subgraph0.o"
  VERBATIM)

add_library(BuckyballSMOLLM STATIC forward.o subgraph0.o)
set_target_properties(BuckyballSMOLLM PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)
add_dependencies(BuckyballSMOLLM smollm-model-build)
add_executable(buddy-buckyball-smollm-run ${MODEL_SMOLLM_DIR}/buddy-smollm-main.cpp)
add_dependencies(buddy-buckyball-smollm-run BuckyballSMOLLM)

target_include_directories(buddy-buckyball-smollm-run PRIVATE ${INTERFACE_DIR})
set(BUDDY_SMOLLM_LIBS BuckyballSMOLLM ModelTestCRunnerUtils)
target_link_libraries(buddy-buckyball-smollm-run -static ${BUDDY_SMOLLM_LIBS})

set(SMOLLM_OUTPUT_DIR ${BUCKYBALL_OUTPUT_DIR}/SmolLM)

add_custom_command(TARGET buddy-buckyball-smollm-run POST_BUILD
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${SMOLLM_OUTPUT_DIR}
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
          $<TARGET_FILE:buddy-buckyball-smollm-run>
          ${SMOLLM_OUTPUT_DIR}/buddy-buckyball-smollm-run
  COMMENT "Copying Buckyball SmolLM executable to output directory"
  VERBATIM
)

add_custom_target(sync-buckyball-smollm-deps
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${SMOLLM_OUTPUT_DIR}
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${SMOLLM_OUTPUT_DIR}/trace/cycle
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
          ${MODEL_SMOLLM_DIR}/arg0.data
          ${SMOLLM_OUTPUT_DIR}/arg0.data
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
          ${MODEL_SMOLLM_DIR}/vocab.txt
          ${SMOLLM_OUTPUT_DIR}/vocab.txt
  DEPENDS
          ${MODEL_SMOLLM_DIR}/arg0.data
          ${MODEL_SMOLLM_DIR}/vocab.txt
  COMMENT "Syncing SmolLM runtime deps to output directory"
  VERBATIM
)

add_dependencies(buddy-buckyball-smollm-run sync-buckyball-smollm-deps)
